questions.q1: I often seek reassurance from other people to feel safe.
questions.q2: I find it difficult to trust my own decisions without asking others.
questions.q3: I feel the need to ask repeatedly if everything is okay.
questions.q4: I search for symptoms or information online to reduce anxiety.
questions.q5: I repeatedly look for answers even after finding an explanation.
questions.q6: I find it difficult to stop searching when I become worried.
questions.q7: I pay close attention to sensations in my body.
questions.q8: I interpret small physical changes as possible signs of danger.
questions.q9: I frequently check if something is wrong with my body.
questions.q10: I feel the need to do things perfectly.
questions.q11: I become uncomfortable when I make small mistakes.
questions.q12: I delay tasks because I fear not doing them well.
questions.q13: I avoid situations because I fear anxiety or discomfort.
questions.q14: I stop doing important things to avoid worries.
questions.q15: I feel immediate relief when I avoid something that causes anxiety.
questions.q16: I get stuck in repetitive thoughts about problems or negative possibilities.
questions.q17: I find it difficult to switch off my mind when I am worried.
questions.q18: I mentally review situations trying to find answers.
questions.q19: I feel the need to control every detail to feel calm.
questions.q20: I find it difficult to accept that some things are unpredictable.
questions.q21: I feel anxious when I cannot guarantee an outcome.
questions.q22: I often compare my life or performance with others.
questions.q23: I feel others handle difficult situations better than I do.
questions.q24: Comparisons make me feel less confident.

reassurance.name: Reassurance Seeking
reassurance.description: You tend to look for external reassurance to feel safe when anxiety appears.
reassurance.strength: You pay attention to details and value security.
reassurance.challenge: Learn to trust your own ability to handle uncertainty.

search.name: Safety Searching
search.description: Looking for answers can bring temporary relief but may keep the anxiety cycle going.
search.strength: You are curious and try to understand what is happening.
search.challenge: Learn to tolerate some uncertainty without needing immediate answers.

body.name: Body Hypervigilance
body.description: You are highly aware of body sensations and may interpret them as danger signals.
body.strength: You have strong awareness of your body.
body.challenge: Learn to notice sensations without always seeing them as threats.

perfectionism.name: Perfectionism
perfectionism.description: You feel a strong need to do things correctly and avoid mistakes.
perfectionism.strength: You are dedicated and committed to doing things well.
perfectionism.challenge: Accept that mistakes are part of learning and growth.

avoidance.name: Avoidance
avoidance.description: Avoiding situations can bring immediate relief but strengthen fear over time.
avoidance.strength: You try to protect yourself when things feel difficult.
avoidance.challenge: Take small steps even when discomfort appears.

rumination.name: Rumination
rumination.description: Your mind can get stuck analysing problems and possible outcomes.
rumination.strength: You have strong reflection and analytical skills.
rumination.challenge: Learn to disconnect and return to the present moment.

control.name: Need for Control
control.description: You may constantly try to guarantee that everything goes well.
control.challenge: Accept that some uncertainty is part of life.

comparison.name: Social Comparison
comparison.description: Comparing yourself with others can affect how you see your own value.
comparison.strength: You observe and learn from people around you.
comparison.challenge: Value your own path and progress.
